description: This file defines the LeavePeriodAPI class which provides REST API endpoints for managing leave periods within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It includes methods to get current and all leave periods, update leave periods, and handles validation rules. The class interacts with services for leave configuration, leave period management, and normalization, and uses traits for additional functionality.

classes.name: LeavePeriodAPI
classes.description: API class providing endpoints to manage leave periods, including retrieving current or all leave periods, updating the leave period configuration, and defining validation rules.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves the current leave period and its history, returning data along with metadata indicating if the leave period is defined.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all generated leave periods along with current leave period info.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates or creates a leave period with specified start month and day, saves the change, and enables the leave module menu if previously not defined.
